 AgentExchange is building the next generation of our ecosystem marketplace, extending the base and boundaries of our platform while infusing intelligence through every step of our partners' and customers' journey. The new ecosystem enables packaging, publishing, and listing solutions across multiple technologies — Agentforce, MuleSoft, Tableau, and Slack — while delivering full transactability (Discover → Purchase → Provision). The One AppExchange Framework is our dynamic, extensible data and services platform that expands the tenancy capabilities of the AgentExchange site. This is not a search\-maintenance role. You will own the technical vision for discovery at scale, drive AI\-native engineering across the search stack, and set the bar for relevance, latency, personalization, and observability across one of the most strategically important surfaces in the AgentExchange.

* Multi\-turn agentic search — conversational discovery with recommendations, comparisons, and contextual follow\-up
* Personalization service — behavioral and preference\-based ranking and recommendations
